observations: Title states EXTREME_LOSS with R=-1.545 and outcome-disclosing for SELL position 1324.
Horizontal levels: solid blue Entry ~1.21854, red dashed SL ~1.21865 above entry, green dashed TP ~1.21832 below entry.
Purple dotted vertical marks break-bar open; blue dash-dot vertical with diamond marks actual entry shortly after.
Pre-entry path is a multi-hour decline from ~1.2194 into the entry zone, then chop near SL/entry before the purple line.
Immediately after actual entry, price prints an X near/above the SL band and fails to drive cleanly toward TP.
Post-entry path stays contested around entry/SL, then trends strongly higher to ~1.2192 (adverse for SELL).
Bottom book panel: CME 6E full-break-bar trace early=+0.097 late=+0.182 score=+0.323; direction-aligned I5 stays mostly positive through the 300s window.
unknowns: Exact fill, exit timestamp, and whether the purple X is stop-exit vs marker only are not labeled in text.

result.entry_context_assessment: SELL is taken after a long down-move into a tight band just under the SL line; break-bar open and actual entry sit where price is already stalling near the stop rather than expanding lower. Entry context is a late-stage downside probe with very little room above before SL.
result.path_anatomy: After the blue actual-entry mark, price does not accept lower toward TP. It immediately contests the SL zone (X near the red line), oscillates around entry/SL without sustained downside follow-through, then expands higher in a strong adverse rally. Realized outcome is extreme loss (R=-1.545), consistent with a failed downside break rather than clean continuation or a long favorable excursion then giveback.
result.book_trace_relevance: The direction-aligned book trace is positive across early/late windows (score=+0.323) and remains mostly above zero through the full break-bar horizon, including near the late actual-entry marker. Visually, the book did not flag this path as hostile; positive book coexists with an extreme losing SELL, so the trace did not discriminate the failed break.
result.exit_geometry_assessment: SL sits only a few ticks above entry while TP is farther below, producing asymmetric tight-stop geometry. Post-entry price immediately presses that upper stop band; the subsequent multi-handle rally is deep adverse relative to the tight risk unit. Cost cannot be isolated, but path geometry shows stop-side failure then further adverse extension on the chart frame.
result.failure_mechanism: Primary failure is setup/entry acceptance: the SELL break does not continue after fill. Price fails immediately at/through the stop band and never establishes downside follow-through, then trends against the position. Book support was positive, so the loss is not explained by a visibly negative book; it is a failed break entry that the trace did not screen out.
